manualSteps: Run npm run books:cloudflare-export && npm run books:cloudflare-export-audit immediately before upload.
Upload/sync app/client/assets/books/cloudflare-export to the configured Cloudflare/R2/public object prefix.
Overwrite existing keys and delete stale remote keys under the export prefix.
Configure VITE_MORSE_BOOK_CONTENT_BASE_URL or PUBLIC_MORSE_BOOK_CONTENT_BASE_URL to the public base URL that serves public-manifest.json and books/<slug>.json.
Run npm run books:cloudflare-post-upload-validation after upload.
Run the deferred route/chapter/nav/view-window validation against the served export path.
